project_info.theme: Elegant bridal portrait in a dim warm hallway
project_info.color_palette: white lace, ivory satin, warm amber, dark wood and soft skin tones

main_subject.detail: Clearly adult woman in a white off-the-shoulder wedding dress with lace details, long white gloves, a delicate necklace and drop earrings. She faces the camera in a refined formal portrait with natural makeup and polished dark hair.
main_subject.style: photorealistic bridal editorial with soft warm glamour

composition_elements.layout: vertical close-up bridal portrait with the subject centered in a dim hallway
composition_elements.background: warmly lit interior hallway with dark architectural details and soft circular practical lights

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: warm low-key hallway lighting with gentle frontal fill
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: soft facial highlights, lace texture and intimate formal bridal atmosphere

technical_specs.optics: portrait lens, shallow depth of field and crisp lace detail

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic portrait of a clearly adult bride in a white off-the-shoulder wedding dress with delicate lace details, wearing long gloves, a necklace and drop earrings. Place her in a dimly lit hallway with warm amber lighting, dark architectural details and soft background bokeh. Use elegant natural makeup, realistic skin texture, refined bridal styling, a portrait lens, shallow depth of field and crisp lace detail. Preserve the source gown, accessories, warm hallway and formal romantic mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, minor, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, distorted lace, duplicate jewelry
